notes: AMENDMENTS-015 B78 chest / loot gating (P4-prep slice). A Cargo Drops row whose source is a container (isfromnpc 0) was 'drop-source-ungated' (containers carried no gating). Listed containers gate their drops on the conditions below, every one quoted from the container's article (checked verbatim): world-generated chests that open freely carry none; locked or progression-held ones carry the boss condition that opens them (node-mapped, so it becomes a boss gate).

Matching is by the source name AND the article the Drops rows live on (`page`): the secret-seed articles ('I am error', 'What a horrible night to have a curse', …) list their seed-only chest loot under the same 'Chest' / 'Gold Chest' names and must never match an ordinary chest.

Not listed (their drops stay Unknown, reasons in the gap report): Shadow Chest (its Shadow Key also comes from lava-fished lock boxes, so Skeletron is not provably the minimum), Obsidian / Golden Lock Box and crates (fishing is not modeled, AMENDMENTS-004 B20), Dead Man's Chest (a trapped chest), Herb Bag / Can Of Worms / Geode / Oyster / Present / Goodie Bag (items whose own acquisition is not modeled).

Biome location (Ice biome, Underground Jungle, Floating Islands…) is where the chest is, not a world condition; only world-state requirements (the world evil) and progression gates are conditions here. Row-level notes already in the Drops data (underground / cavern) are kept as they are.

worldSpecificLoot: the chest loot tables state the ore-tier bars per world ('Iron Bar(in worlds with Iron)'), which the Cargo Drops rows do not carry — a registered container's drop of such an item also carries the world-ore condition. With the exhaustive ore-pair groups (overlays/conditions.json) 'Any Iron Bar' stays gate-free (Iron Bars in Iron worlds OR Lead Bars in Lead worlds), while a recipe that needs one specific bar does not.
